About Me

Hi, I’m Hongrui Yin (Vincent), an undergraduate at CUHK-Shenzhen. My earlier research focused on cross-view geo-localization (CVGL), matching ground or aerial images to satellite imagery. More recently, I’ve been working on embodied AI and agentic systems, focusing on how robots can generalize to new settings and complete tasks reliably.

Beyond Invariance: Learning the Geographic Core for Generalizable Cross-View Geo-Localization

Hongyang Zhang, Maonan Wang, Hongrui Yin, Ziyi Wang, Man-On Pun*

AAAI 2027 · Under review

Sketch First, Details Later: Reliability-Guided Self-Supervised Cross-View Geo-Localization

Hongrui Yin, Hongyang Zhang, Ziyi Wang, Man-On Pun*

RSGeo combines reliability-guided training on synthetic views with optimal matching to learn from real panorama–satellite pairs.

ICML 2026

InfoGeo: Information-Theoretic Object-Centric Learning for Cross-View Generalizable UAV Geo-Localization

Hongyang Zhang†, Maonan Wang†, Ziyao Wang, Hongrui Yin, Man On Pun*

Learns object-centric representations for UAV geo-localization across viewpoints and geographic regions.
